## Workload

During the quarter, grader Tomas Brennan completed 811 reads over 417 hours. This represents an average of 1.9 reads per hour. The workload information provides the basis for the review of both activity levels and reading performance. The recorded figures indicate the total number of reads completed and the time spent undertaking that work.

## Quality

A sample of 70 reads was checked as part of the quality review. The agreement rate was 52.9 per cent. The findings were considered by Tomas Brennan and reviewer Priya Anand, who agreed to maintain the current session pattern. The review records the level of agreement identified through the checked sample and provides a basis for ongoing monitoring. Priya Anand completed the review.
